cases.userPrompt: Show Aaron Judge's recent Sportfolio-relevant performance.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve the player if necessary, then use get_player_detail or get_player_recent_games. No OAuth connection is required and no account state changes.

expectedResultShape.data: public player detail or recent game log

cases.userPrompt: Show my Sportfolio portfolio and summarize my largest virtual positions.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use get_portfolio_summary after OAuth connection. Explain that values are virtual and identify the largest holdings without changing account state.
cases.fixture: Reviewer account has at least eight MLB holdings with varied virtual values.

cases.userPrompt: Buy 25 virtual Sportfolio bucks of Aaron Judge after showing me the exact preview.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve Aaron Judge, call stage_market_buy, present the virtual cost and expected position/balance impact, obtain explicit confirmation, and only then call confirm_pending_action with the exact pending bundle. Never claim success from the staging result alone.

expectedResultShape.data: staged preview followed by a confirmed virtual market transaction

cases.fixture: Reviewer account has enough virtual balance to buy 25 Sportfolio bucks of Aaron Judge and no conflicting pending action.

cases.userPrompt: Find my best eligible daily boost candidate and assign it after I confirm the preview.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use the read tools needed to identify an eligible candidate, call stage_daily_boost_assign, show the player, slot, sport, and preview, obtain explicit confirmation, then call confirm_pending_action for the reviewed bundle.

expectedResultShape.data: candidate analysis, staged boost preview, and confirmed assignment

cases.fixture: Reviewer account has an open daily boost slot and at least one eligible owned player.

cases.userPrompt: Create a watchlist called Review Targets and add Aaron Judge to it.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve the player, call create_watchlist, then add_watchlist_player using the created watchlist identifier. Report each completed change and do not alter holdings or execute a trade.

expectedResultShape.data: created watchlist and added player result

cases.fixture: Reviewer account does not already have a watchlist named Review Targets.
